p: And the captain of the guard: From Jer 40:2-42:7 it seems to be as a parenthesis and separated matter and there this story begins again and this vision is declared what it was.
sinned against the LORD: God moved this infidel to speak this to declare the great blindness and obstinacy of the Jews who could not feel that which this heathen man confessed.
Mizpah: Which was a city of Judah.
who were in the fields: Which were scattered abroad for fear of the Chaldeans.
Ishmael the son of Nethaniah: Who was of the king's blood and later slew him, Jer 41:2.
Moab: Which were fed also for fear of the Chaldeans.
Baalis the king of the Ammonites: For under the colour of entertaining Ishmael, he sought only to make them destroy one another.
not do this thing: Thus the godly who think no harm to others are soonest deceived and never lack such as conspire their destruction.
